capabilities: toggle hiding of interface elements via hotkey or click
focus only the active pane with Super Focus Mode
customize the hidden state with CSS classes and snippets
extras: Includes manual installation steps (copying main.js, styles.css, manifest.json into the plugins folder); Super Focus Mode is triggered by Shift + Left Click or a dedicated hotkey.
problem: Obsidian's interface chrome (sidebars, tabs, toolbars) stays visible while writing, which can distract from the note being edited.
summary: Plugin that adds a toggle and hotkeys to hide Obsidian interface elements so only the note content is visible.
